answer: Auction work slots: agents bid POA, the top K win, each winning bid locks for 20 epochs. A lotus grows one bloom per root; one slot takes one winning bid; to seize 100 slots an attacker must outbid honest bidders 100 times. At a 400 POA clearing price, 100 fake slots lock 40,000 POA for 25,000 POA of payouts, a 15,000 POA loss. Honest agents pay once and earn the payout; the summit bid at the auction's zenith prices real work.
